subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: Should command-secret resolution skip the gateway RPC for active exec-backed target SecretRefs and resolve them locally when local exec is allowed?
rationale: The code path fixes the reported log flood, but it changes an auth/security-sensitive execution boundary by choosing local SecretRef execution before contacting the gateway for those active targets.

options.title: Accept guarded local skip
options.body: Land this shape after branch refresh and the diagnostic copy fix, treating active exec-backed command targets as a known local-resolution case.

options.title: Keep gateway-first semantics
options.body: Reject this PR and tolerate the current generic `UNAVAILABLE` noise until a gateway-owned command-secret contract changes.

options.title: Require runtime-side redesign
options.body: Supersede this PR with a broader gateway/runtime-command-secret change if maintainers want partial snapshot success rather than CLI preflight skipping.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded local skip
recommendation.body: Land this shape after branch refresh and the diagnostic copy fix, treating active exec-backed command targets as a known local-resolution case.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the remaining choice is acceptance of the auth/security boundary, not a narrow contributor-only repair.
